       (i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::float as gift_val_usd,
       i.sess_dur_min

LIMIT 5;

WITH fan_fmi AS (
    SELECT 
        i.interact_fan_pivot,
        (i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::float / i.sess_dur_min AS fmi
    FROM interactions i
),

    SELECT 
        interact_fan_pivot,
        MAX(fmi) AS spending_score
    FROM fan_fmi
    GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
)

       ms.spend_usd / NULLIF(ms.memb_days::float / 30.44, 0) AS ffv
FROM membershipandspending ms
JOIN fans f ON ms.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry

WITH fan_fmi AS (
    SELECT 
        i.interact_fan_pivot,
        ROUND(CAST((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd') AS numeric) / CAST(i.sess_dur_min AS numeric), 2) AS fmi
    FROM interactions i
),
fan_peak AS (
    SELECT 
        interact_fan_pivot,
        MAX(fmi) AS peak_monetization_index
    FROM fan_fmi
    GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
)
SELECT 
    f.nick_label,
    fp.interact_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
    fp.peak_monetization_index,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fp.peak_monetization_index DESC) AS fmi_rank
FROM fan_peak fp
JOIN fans f ON fp.interact_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
ORDER BY fp.peak_monetization_index DESC
LIMIT 10;
